Committee Policy Actions In support of the Committee's dual-mandate goals, all members agreed to raise the target range for the federal funds rate 1/4 percentage point to 3-3/4 to 4 percent and reaffirmed the FOMC's policy of maintaining ample reserves in the banking system.
